biotools.summary: PNcsp+ is an enhanced, chemically interpretable framework for Crystal Structure Prediction (CSP) that leverages the Mendeleev Periodic Number (PN) to guide elemental similarity. It combines state-of-the-art neural networks (MACE, M3GNet, ALIGNN-FF) for accelerated, accurate prediction of crystal structures in both inorganic and hybrid chemical spaces.
